summary: Decoded the engine's 'REVIEW PC' flow end-to-end. The screen is dead simple: load the character record from pcfile.dbs, render the char sheet (same machinery as creation), wait for Enter, return. No skillTrain panel; BONUS row is hidden via the *0x56ac = -1 sentinel. 90% of the work is already done in our existing creation port — the only new pieces are roster_io_one_record (already ported as decodePcfile) and the menu picker that selects which character to view.

steps.purpose: Create persistent windows (top, bottomBar, menuPanel). Already ported as createPersistentWindows().
Read one 432-byte character record from pcfile.dbs into the staging buffer at DGROUP 0x5470. Mode 0 = read; mode 1 = write. Already ported as decodePcfile() in packages/parser.
Set the bonus-pool sentinel to -1; the char-sheet renderer hides the BONUS row when *0x56ac < 0. This is the key UI difference between creation (BONUS shown 0..26) and review (BONUS hidden).

Load this character's portrait tiles into wfont2 glyphs 0x48..0x50. Reads from wportN.EGA where N = (portraitIdx / 14) + 1; reads 288 bytes (9 tiles × 32 bytes) at file offset (portraitIdx % 14) * 288. Already mirrored by patchFontSetWithPortrait() in skill-train-frame.ts.
Write chars 0x48..0x50 in a 3×3 grid at top window (1..3, 1..3) attr 0x02. NOT a frame — just the tile placement. Already mirrored by the top-window overlay loop in composeSkillTrainFrame.
Row 1 col 4: NAME (attr 0x50). Col 13: sex glyph + '-' + race name (attr 0x10). Row 2 col 13: class name (attr 0x10). Already ported as drawHeader in char-sheet.ts.
Age fields (rows 2/3 col 5..7), LVL value, RNK label, EXP value, MKS value, rank title (row 1 right), 6 wfont2 icons + bottom-grid cur/max pairs. Already ported as drawRedrawFields in char-sheet.ts.
STR..KAR rows + HP cur/max + STM cur/max + BONUS row (hidden when *0x56ac<0). Already ported as drawStatPanel in char-sheet.ts.

afterReturn: Return to caller (the roster picker loop)

rosterPicker.purpose: Lists existing characters by name (read from pcfile.dbs slot-by-slot, slot 0xFF = empty). Player picks one with arrow keys + Enter; the picked index is passed to wpcmk_view_character. (Not yet fully decompiled here — TODO if we need to RE the picker layout.)

newPiecesNeeded: Read characters from the LIVE roster store (localStorage in our port; pcfile.dbs in the engine) — already have lib/roster-store.ts.
A 'review' screen that mirrors the engine flow: drawCharSheet + persistent portrait + no BONUS + wait for Enter to return.
Wire the existing CharacterMenuScreen 'REVIEW PC' option to either: (a) navigate to a new review screen, or (b) reuse a per-character detail page.

bonusRowGate.claim: *0x56ac is the bonus-pool register. -1 = not active (BONUS row hidden). 0..26 = creation pool (BONUS row visible). The char-sheet renderer in our port already gates this — drawStatPanel only renders BONUS when draft.bonusPool >= 0.
bonusRowGate.implication: Our drawCharSheet will correctly hide BONUS for a roster-loaded character if we pass bonusPool: -1.

findings.claim: wpcmk_view_character is a 2-call wrapper (load_and_draw + wait); the render itself is 8 calls that reuse the creation char-sheet machinery exactly
*0x56ac = 0xffff (-1) is the 'no bonus pool' sentinel; the renderer skips the BONUS row when negative. This is the key UI difference between creation and review screens.
findings.evidence: wpcmk_load_and_draw_character writes 0xffff to *0x56ac before calling the render functions. Cross-checked vs creation flow where *0x56ac is set to the rolled pool value (0..26).

findings.claim: Reviewing a character calls portrait_load_from_disk to patch wfont2 with that character's portrait tiles — same mechanism as the post-portrait creation flow. Subsequent screens (rest of the game) inherit the patched wfont2 until another portrait is loaded.
findings.evidence: wpcmk_load_and_draw_character calls portrait_load_from_disk(*0x560c) after roster_io_one_record. *0x560c is populated by the read from pcfile.dbs.

findings.claim: ui_draw_portrait_frame is just the 3×3 tile-grid placement at (x, y)..(x+2, y+2) using chars 0x48..0x50 at attr 0x02 — no decorative frame chrome
findings.evidence: Decompile of wpcmk 0x0c12 shows 9 consecutive ui_window_putchar calls at attr 0x02 with chars 0x48..0x50; no extra border characters.

unresolved: wpcmk_show_roster_picker layout (the menu that selects which character to review) — not RE'd yet; needed only if we want to faithfully reproduce the in-game picker. Our port can use the existing RosterView instead.
